exercises.why: **скроют** — скрыть (perfective): to hide, to conceal; to dissemble, to keep back; to keep secret. Wiktionary: с- + крыть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: bedspread, bedcover (topmost covering of a bed)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: скрыть — to hide, to conceal; открыва́ться — to open; кры́шка — cover, lid; покрыва́ло — bedspread, bedcover (topmost covering of a bed).
**открывается** — открыва́ться (imperfective): to open; to come to light; to confide, to open up, to declare oneself. Wiktionary: открыва́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **покрывает** — покрыва́ть (imperfective): to cover; to drown out; (agriculture) to mount (an animal to mate); to extend (to possess a certain extent; to cover an amount of space). Wiktionary: покры́ть + -ва́ть.

exercises.why: **Накрой** — накры́ть (perfective): to cover (from above, e.g. with a lid); (military) to hit, to place fire on a target, to trap (from above, e.g. of artillery fire or bombing); (intransitive, ) to lay (a table); (colloquial) to catch (in the act). Wiktionary: на- + крыть.
